Original Decipher card face for [[Great Shot, Kid!]], as shown in the card list on Decipher's own website.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/greatshotkid.jpg greatshotkid.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030104050049/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/greatshotkid.jpg Internet Archive], 4 January 2003. SHA-256 of the archived file: e0e7fc76e2e0d794948723bf64ebfe776bc3d571b01cc98c38bcb6fe7c92286e.

Edits: none. The archived bytes are uploaded unchanged.

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-L-greatshotkid.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file. The older file [[:File:Tat-L-greatshotkid-pc2007.gif|File:Tatooine-L-greatshotkid-decipher-archive.gif]] is not a Decipher scan: it is the Players Committee's 2007 card-gallery image of the PC errata wording (Rules Supplement of 9 February 2004). This scan is the printed card; Decipher's own card page of 2 August 2001 already showed it ([https://web.archive.org/web/20010802094636/http://www.decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/greatshotkid.html Great Shot, Kid! card page] on Decipher.com (Internet Archive, 2 August 2001)).

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
